Full-file pass. `findIcons` caps per-repository rows only for an empty term; with search text it fetches all icon id/name/url rows, ranks and sorts them in JS, then slices to limitPerGroup. The IconPicker sends debounced searches (250 ms) with a 24-result cap. The response is bounded, but DB→process data, per-query CPU and temporary ranking structures scale with catalog size; catalog count and latency/heap are unmeasured.
reason: Non-empty icon searches materialize and rank all icon rows before slicing the response. Catalog size and runtime impact are not measured; see report for the bounded claim and missing evidence.
